stage_b_v1.why: Two halves: the official story (the Pope asked, the appeal failed, no truce was agreed) and the turn 'Nobody asked the men in the trenches.' During the official part the camera holds and watches the two men by the fire (only the fire and the sky live); on 'Nobody' it pushes in, so the only camera move lands on the line that matters. The next shot S02_SH009 is a push too, so this one must not crawl from frame 0.

seen.what: Dusk in a front-line trench: young Thomas (left) holds a mug, Sergeant Harris (right) leans on his knees; a brazier burns between them in front, a candle in a dugout niche on the left, coiled wire against a violet sky with the first stars.
